## About
Brandywine Auto Parts is a warehouse distributor of name brand auto parts and chemicals, with a store on 9th Street in Chester. We serve the general public and automotive repair shops too.
If you're a repair facility looking for a parts supplier or you work on your own vehicles, come see us. One reviewer calls us a nice old school auto parts stop, and another says the service was fast, accurate, and friendly.

## Services
- Name brand auto parts and chemicals: Name brand parts and chemicals, from a warehouse distributor.
- Retail auto parts store: Open to the general public, for folks who work on their own cars.
- Warehouse distribution for repair shops: Warehouse distribution that serves automotive repair shops.
- Expedited delivery services: Expedited delivery for wholesale customers.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only sell to repair shops?
A: No. We have retail stores serving the general public as well as warehouse distribution for repair shops.

Q: Do you carry parts for foreign cars?
A: Yes. We cover a variety of automotive needs for both domestic and foreign vehicles.

Q: Can I call ahead for a price?
A: Sure. One customer says when he calls to get prices on parts, he always gets the help he needs.

Q: Is the store accessible?
A: One reviewer mentions a big parking lot and a handicap accessible entrance.
